defs.def: the mother of your father or mother （外）祖母；奶奶；外婆

ex.s: Evelyn Donohue is a 65-year-old grandma.
ex.t: Evelyn Donohue是一位65岁的祖母。

ex.s: Awake from a short sleep in her chair, my grandmother ran her fingers through her wavy white hair, looked out her window at the blue sky, and asked me what I would wish for if I had just one wish.
ex.t: 祖母从椅子上的短暂小睡中醒来，手指捋过波浪般的白发，望向窗外蓝天，问我如果只有一个愿望，我会许什么愿。

ex.s: My grandmother was born in Ireland.
ex.t: 我的祖母出生在爱尔兰。

ex.s: At 28, my grandmother walked herself through the snow to birth her first child.
ex.t: 28岁时，我的祖母独自踏着雪去生下她的第一个孩子。

ex.s: Even at 93, my grandmother still knits blankets for the local hospital’s babies and buys books to continue with her French.
ex.t: 即使到了93岁，我的祖母仍然为当地医院的婴儿织毯子，还买书继续学法语。

ex.s: Why did the author’s grandmother recycle the same answers to his questions? (no more than 10 words)
ex.t: 为什么作者的祖母总是用同样的答案回答他的问题？（不超过10个词）

ex.s: How can people be successful in old age according to the author’s grandmother? (no more than 10 words)
ex.t: 根据作者祖母的说法，人们如何才能在老年活得精彩？（不超过10个词）

ex.s: “Some people ask me, ‘So what’s the worth of artificial life?’ Do you ever think, ‘What is the worth of your grandmother?’”
ex.t: "有人问我，'那人工生命有什么价值？'你有没有想过，'你祖母的价值是什么？'"

ex.s: His mother, grandmother and great grandmother were all born at the reserve and still live there.
ex.t: 它的母亲、祖母和曾祖母都出生在保护区并且仍然生活在那里。

ex.s: They lived with their grandmothers.
ex.t: 她们和祖母一起生活。

ex.s: "I'm going to put it in my Grandma's Box."
ex.t: “我要把它放进我的奶奶箱子里。”

ex.s: My imaginary Grandma's Box worked like magic that spring, and later.
ex.t: 我想象中的奶奶箱子在那个春天像魔法一样奏效，后来也是如此。

ex.s: Then someone said, "Now you can use your Grandma's Box." From then on instead of coming to ask their possessions back, the students would say, "That's okay.
ex.t: 然后有人说,"现在你可以用你奶奶的盒子了",从那时起，学生们不但没有来问回他们的财物，反而会说:"没关系。

ex.s: Put it in your Grandma's Box for Gordon."
ex.t: 我喜欢谈论那个想象中的箱子，不仅和我的学生们，还有我自己的孩子。

ex.s: Then one Christmas I received a surprise gift—a large, beautifully made wooden chest My son Bruce had made my Grandma's Box a reality.
ex.t: 后来有一年圣诞节，我收到一份惊喜礼物——一只大而精美的木箱。我儿子布鲁斯让我的“奶奶的箱子”变成了现实。

ex.s: The maker of the Grandma's Box.
ex.t: 奶奶箱子的制作者。

ex.s: They asked to see the Grandma's Box.
ex.t: 他们要求看看"奶奶的盒子"。

ex.s: She is a responsible grandmother
ex.t: 她是一位负责任的奶奶

ex.s: Remember that Thomas Costain was 57 when he published his first novel, and that Grandma Moses showed her first pictures when she was 78.
ex.t: 记住，托马斯·科斯坦57岁时才出版了他的第一部小说，而摩西奶奶78岁时才展出了她的第一批画作。

ex.s: She said，“We don't have any idea who put grandma forward.
ex.t: 她说："我们不知道是谁推荐了奶奶。

ex.s: The baby was born and update texts were    47    quickly from the overjoyed grandmother, Teresa.
ex.t: 婴儿出生了，欣喜的祖母特蕾莎___47___迅速地发来了报喜短信。

ex.s: So we still need to prepare food and drinks I'll make a checklist Preparation choose presents for Grandma draw up the guest list on Wednesday make invitations prepare food and drinks on Sunday morning Who's responsible?
ex.t: 所以我们还需要准备食物和饮料。我来列个清单：准备——给奶奶选礼物；星期三拟好客人名单；做邀请函；准备食物和饮料；星期天早上——谁负责？

ex.s: With the help of her grandmother, eight-year-old Khloe Thompson started making “Kare Bags” for the homeless people in her district.
ex.t: 在祖母的帮助下，八岁的Khloe Thompson开始为她所在社区的无家可归者制作"Kare Bags"。

ex.s: The Tangshan earthquake was a terrible experience that my great-grandma cannot forget.
ex.t: 唐山大地震是我曾祖母无法忘记的可怕经历。

chunks.cn: 椅子 我的 祖母
